answer: Randomised submission windows at the summit: each epoch opens at an unpredictable block, so one operator must run k identities 24/7 to catch every slot. A signal check enforces per-identity uptime variance across the mesa of timestamps. Attacker cost: ~500 CPU-hours plus $12/window per identity to avoid misses; twenty identities exceed $4,800/epoch with no guaranteed inclusion. This works because temporal diversity makes parallel farming linearly expensive.
